relationships.subject: wrist-ankle acupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: decreased NR2B/VGluT2-related measures and downstream markers (p-JNK, p-CREB, and CGRP)

relationships.subject: α7 nicotinic acetylcholine receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: neuronal α7nAChR in the spinal dorsal horn is required for the analgesic effect of WAA in this paclitaxel-induced CIPN model

key_findings: Wrist-ankle acupuncture relieved paclitaxel-induced allodynia and hyperalgesia and lowered dorsal horn glutamate, NR2B, VGluT2, p-JNK, p-CREB and CGRP.
Effects were blunted by intrathecal NMDAR agonist and by neuronal or VGluT2-neuron-specific Chrna7 deletion.
